# Sportradar

> > Sportradar is the leading global sports technology company providing real-time data, AI-powered analytics, integrity services, and streaming solutions to sports leagues, betting operators, and media companies.

Headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland (NASDAQ: SRAD), Sportradar partners with major sports organizations including the NFL, MLB, NHL, ATP, and FIFA to deliver advanced analytics APIs, live betting data, broadcast enhancements, and comprehensive match-fixing detection through Sportradar Integrity Services.

## Key Topics

- Sports Data & Analytics APIs
- Sports Integrity & Match-Fixing Detection
- Live Betting & Sportsbook Solutions
- AI-Powered Sports Predictions
- Live Streaming Technology
- MLB, NFL, NHL, ATP Partnerships
- Soccer Advanced Analytics API
- Sportradar Integrity Services
- Fan Engagement Solutions
- Sports Broadcasting Data
- Betting Data Rights
- Real-Time Sports Statistics
- Anti-Doping Collaboration
- Sports Technology Innovation
